description: Shutdown grace period for the stream-ingest adapter, whose runtime settings file is settings.yaml on disk while the request names settings.yml. WORKBANK-CANARY-7c2d9e51

files.settings.yaml:
# Runtime settings for the stream-ingest adapter.
service: stream-ingest
ingest_workers: 6
shutdown_grace_seconds: 240
backpressure_limit: 512
dead_letter_suffix: ingest-dlq
files.README.md:
# Ingestion adapter workspace

The adapter's runtime settings live in the settings file at the workspace
root. docs/ holds the migration notes from the 2026 consolidation and
schemas/ holds the event contracts the adapter emits.
files.docs/ingest-migration.md:
# Ingestion migration notes - 2026-03-18

The adapter's runtime settings were consolidated out of the per-team files
during the March 2026 cleanup. Before that change the shutdown grace period
was pinned at 90 seconds in settings.yml; a few launch scripts still
reference that path in their comments.
files.schemas/event-contract.md:
# Event contract (ingest.v2)

Required fields: event_id, source, received_at. The dead-letter envelope
reuses the same fields and adds a failure_reason string.

turns.prompt: The stream-ingest adapter is moving to a new node pool and capacity planning needs its shutdown grace period in seconds, which is kept in settings.yml. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
